subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Social Media as an Investigation Tool
description: Learn Social Media as an Investigation Tool in one minute.

hook.text: A man claims a debilitating back injury. His Instagram shows him completing a marathon.

buildup.text: Insurance investigators now routinely check claimants' social media for contradicting evidence.

discovery.text: Vacation photos, gym check-ins, and activity posts have disproven thousands of disability claims.

twist.text: Even private accounts can be subpoenaed during fraud investigations.

climax.text: Social media has become one of the most powerful and cheapest fraud detection tools available.

punchline.text: He posted the proof. The investigator just had to scroll.

quiz.question: Can private social media accounts be used in fraud investigations?
